grammar: n. 节奏；韵律。可数，复数 rhythms；rhythm of... 表示……的节奏。
collocations: keep the rhythm; a steady rhythm; the rhythm of a song
commonMistake: rhythm 的拼写中元音字母少，注意中间是 y；表达歌曲节奏用 rhythm，不是歌词 lyric。

example.english: The drummer kept a steady rhythm throughout the song.
example.chinese: 整首歌中，鼓手都保持着稳定的节奏。

application.prompt: The drummer tapped evenly while the band played. He kept the ___ of the song. A. rhythm B. costume
application.solution: A。解析：鼓点稳定地配合音乐，指保持歌曲的 rhythm（节奏）。

grammar: adj. 民间的；n. 人们，常用 folks（口语）。folk music 指民间音乐。
collocations: folk music; folk song; local folk
commonMistake: folk 作“民间的”时放在名词前作定语；folk music 不等于 pop music（流行音乐）。

example.english: The village band played a folk song at the festival.
example.chinese: 村里的乐队在节日上演奏了一首民歌。

application.prompt: The song has been passed down in the village for generations. It is a ___ song. A. electronic B. folk
application.solution: B。解析：世代流传的村落歌曲属于 folk song（民歌）。

grammar: adj. 古典音乐的；古典的。常修饰 music、composer、concert 等名词。
collocations: classical music; a classical composer; a classical concert
commonMistake: 表示“古典音乐”说 classical music；classical 是形容词，名词是 classic（经典作品或典范）。

example.english: My grandfather listens to classical music every morning.
example.chinese: 我爷爷每天早上听古典音乐。

application.prompt: The orchestra performed a work by Mozart at the concert. The audience enjoyed ___ music. A. classical B. noisy
application.solution: A。解析：莫扎特的管弦乐作品属于 classical music（古典音乐）。

grammar: n. 流行音乐；v.（突然）出现、发出砰声。pop music 中 pop 作名词修饰 music。
collocations: pop music; a pop song; pop into one's head
commonMistake: pop music 是固定表达；这里的 pop 不表示 popcorn，也不把 music 写成复数。

example.english: Her new pop song became popular with teenagers.
example.chinese: 她的新流行歌曲很受青少年欢迎。

application.prompt: The singer's catchy new song is on the charts this week. It is a ___ song. A. opera B. pop
application.solution: B。解析：上榜且旋律流行的新歌属于 pop song（流行歌曲）。

grammar: n. 爵士乐，通常不可数；表示一种音乐时一般不加 a，也不加复数 -s。
collocations: jazz music; a jazz band; a jazz club
commonMistake: jazz 表示音乐类型时通常不可数，说 listen to jazz，不说 listen to a jazz。

example.english: A jazz band played in the small club last night.
example.chinese: 昨晚一支爵士乐队在这家小俱乐部演出。

application.prompt: The saxophone player improvised with the band at the club. They were playing ___. A. jazz B. poetry
application.solution: A。解析：萨克斯即兴演奏是爵士乐演出常见的特点，此处用不可数名词 jazz。

grammar: n. 说唱乐；v. 说唱。过去式和过去分词通常为 rapped，动词现在分词为 rapping。
collocations: rap music; a rap song; rap about something
commonMistake: rap 作动词变过去式要双写 p：rapped；不要误写成 raped。

example.english: The young artist rapped about life in his city.
example.chinese: 这位年轻艺人用说唱讲述了他所在城市的生活。

application.prompt: The performer spoke the rhyming lines over a strong beat. She was ___. A. painting B. rapping
application.solution: B。解析：伴着节拍押韵说词是 rap（说唱）；句中用现在进行时 rapping。

grammar: adj. 传统的；习俗的。名词 tradition；副词 traditionally。
collocations: traditional music; traditional clothes; a traditional festival
commonMistake: 名词 tradition 变形容词要加 -al：traditional；不要把 traditional 拼成 traditionary。

example.english: The dancers wore traditional clothes from the region.
example.chinese: 舞者们穿着这个地区的传统服饰。

application.prompt: The dance has been performed at this festival for hundreds of years. It is a ___ dance. A. traditional B. temporary
application.solution: A。解析：延续数百年的舞蹈具有传统性，应填 traditional。

grammar: phr. 随着……跳舞。dance to 后接音乐、歌曲或节拍，to 是介词。
collocations: dance to music; dance to a beat; dance to a song
commonMistake: dance to 后接音乐名词；表示伴着音乐跳舞不能漏掉 to，也不说 dance with the music。

example.english: The children danced to the music at the school party.
example.chinese: 孩子们在学校派对上随着音乐跳舞。

application.prompt: When the band began its lively song, everyone moved in time with it. They began to ___. A. dance across music B. dance to the music
application.solution: B。解析：表示“随着音乐跳舞”用 dance to the music，to 后接音乐。

grammar: phr. 随着……一起唱。sing along to 后接歌曲或音乐；along 是副词，to 是介词。
collocations: sing along to a song; sing along to the radio; sing along with the singer
commonMistake: sing along to a song 表示跟着歌曲唱；along 不能放在 to 后面组成 sing to along。

example.english: We sang along to our favorite song on the bus.
example.chinese: 我们在公交车上跟着最喜欢的歌一起唱。

application.prompt: Everyone knew the chorus, so they joined in while the recording played. They began to ___. A. sing along to it B. sing it along to
application.solution: A。解析：代词 it 放在短语后接的宾语位置，结构是 sing along to it，意为跟着它唱。

grammar: n. 歌词（常用复数 lyrics）；adj. 抒情的。a lyric 是一行歌词或一首抒情诗。
collocations: song lyrics; write the lyrics; a lyric poem
commonMistake: 一首歌的歌词通常说 lyrics（复数）；表示整段歌词时不说 a lyric，除非指其中一行。

example.english: I looked up the lyrics before the karaoke party.
example.chinese: 卡拉 OK 派对前，我查了这首歌的歌词。

application.prompt: I know the melody, but I cannot remember all the words of the song. I cannot remember the ___. A. rhythms B. lyrics
application.solution: B。解析：歌曲中的词句是 lyrics（歌词）；rhythm 指节奏。

grammar: adj. 电的；令人激动的。名词 electricity；副词 electrically。
collocations: electric current; an electric guitar; an electric shock
commonMistake: electric 作形容词修饰 guitar、car 等；表示“电”这一名词用 electricity，不能写 an electric。

example.english: The electric lights came on as the room grew dark.
example.chinese: 房间暗下来时，电灯亮了。

application.prompt: The guitar needs a cable and an amplifier to produce its sound. It is an ___ guitar. A. electricity B. electric
application.solution: B。解析：名词 guitar 前需要形容词 electric（电的）；electricity 是名词。

grammar: n. 电吉他。可数名词，复数 electric guitars；electric 作前置定语修饰 guitar。
collocations: play an electric guitar; electric guitar solo; a guitar amplifier
commonMistake: electric guitar 是一种乐器；有 amplifier（放大器）不代表乐器变成 keyboard，二者是不同乐器。

example.english: Leo played an electric guitar solo at the concert.
example.chinese: 利奥在音乐会上演奏了一段电吉他独奏。

application.prompt: The musician plugged the instrument into an amplifier before the show. Which instrument did he prepare? A. a flute B. an electric guitar
application.solution: B。解析：需要接入放大器演奏的吉他是 electric guitar（电吉他）。

grammar: n. 电子琴；键盘。可数，复数 keyboards；computer keyboard 指电脑键盘。
collocations: play the keyboard; a computer keyboard; keyboard player
commonMistake: keyboard 可指乐器或电脑输入设备；在乐队里 play the keyboard 指弹奏键盘乐器，不是打字。

example.english: Mina plays the keyboard in the school band.
example.chinese: 米娜在学校乐队里弹电子琴。

application.prompt: At rehearsal, Mina used both hands to play the black and white keys of an electronic instrument. She played the ___. A. keyboard B. trumpet
application.solution: A。解析：用双手弹黑白琴键的电子乐器是 keyboard（电子琴）。

grammar: n. 小号；喇叭。可数，复数 trumpets；演奏者是 trumpet player。
collocations: play the trumpet; a trumpet player; a trumpet solo
commonMistake: 表示演奏某种乐器，乐器前通常加 the：play the trumpet；不是 play trumpet。

example.english: The trumpet sounded clearly above the other instruments.
example.chinese: 小号的声音清晰地盖过了其他乐器。

application.prompt: The brass musician blew into the shiny instrument and played a high note. She played the ___. A. violin B. trumpet
application.solution: B。解析：用气吹奏的铜管乐器是 trumpet（小号），violin 是弦乐器。

grammar: n. 风格；方式。可数，复数 styles；style of... 表示……的风格。
collocations: a musical style; a personal style; in the style of
commonMistake: style 表示某人或作品的风格；表示“方式”时常用 style of doing，不把 style 当作动作本身。

example.english: The singer has a style that is easy to recognize.
example.chinese: 这位歌手的风格很容易辨认。

application.prompt: The singer mixes folk sounds with modern beats, so her music has a unique ___. A. style B. volume
application.solution: A。解析：民间元素与现代节拍构成她独特的音乐 style（风格）。

grammar: n. 一件；一片；一首（乐曲）；一篇。可数，复数 pieces；a piece of music 指一首乐曲。
collocations: a piece of music; a piece of advice; a piece of paper
commonMistake: 数一首乐曲可说 a piece of music；music 本身通常不可数，不说 a music。

example.english: The pianist played a short piece by Chopin.
example.chinese: 钢琴家演奏了一首肖邦的短曲。

application.prompt: The pianist chose one short composition for the opening. She played a ___ of music. A. song B. piece
application.solution: B。解析：a piece of music 表示“一首乐曲”，piece 是合适的表达；song 不与 of music 这样搭配。

grammar: n. 演出；表演；表现。动词 perform；表演者 performer；复数 performances。
collocations: give a performance; a live performance; a musical performance
commonMistake: performance 是名词，前面可用 a；动词“表演”用 perform，不能说 give a perform。

example.english: The audience cheered after the band's performance.
example.chinese: 乐队演出结束后，观众欢呼起来。

application.prompt: The band finished its live show, and the audience stood up to clap. The ___ was a great success. A. performer B. performance
application.solution: B。解析：句子需要指整场演出的名词 performance；performer 指表演者。

grammar: adj. 金色的；珍贵的、极好的。名词 gold；golden hour 指日落前后光线柔和的时段。
collocations: golden hair; a golden opportunity; golden sunlight
commonMistake: gold 可作名词“金”或形容词“金质的”；golden 常描写金色光泽或珍贵事物，如 golden sunlight。

example.english: The setting sun filled the room with golden light.
example.chinese: 落日的余晖让房间洒满金色的光。

application.prompt: The last sunlight made the leaves look bright and warm. They shone in the ___ light. A. dark B. golden
application.solution: B。解析：明亮温暖的落日光线是 golden light（金色的光）；dark 与上下文相反。

grammar: n. 爱好者；情人。由 love 加 -r 构成，复数 lovers；music lover 指音乐爱好者。
collocations: a music lover; a lover of art; nature lovers
commonMistake: lover 可指某事物的爱好者，也可指恋人；说音乐爱好者用 music lover，语境决定具体含义。

example.english: As a jazz lover, he visits the club every Friday.
example.chinese: 作为爵士乐爱好者，他每周五都会去那家俱乐部。

application.prompt: Ella owns hundreds of records and never misses a concert. She is a real music ___. A. lover B. driver
application.solution: A。解析：收藏唱片、常去音乐会的人是 music lover（音乐爱好者）。

grammar: adj. 浪漫的；爱情的。名词 romance；romantically 是副词。
collocations: a romantic song; a romantic story; a romantic evening
commonMistake: romantic 的名词形式是 romance；描述歌曲气氛用 romantic，不用 romance 作形容词。

example.english: They chose a romantic song for their first dance.
example.chinese: 他们为第一支舞选了一首浪漫的歌曲。

application.prompt: The film tells a love story and ends with a wedding. It is a ___ film. A. comic B. romantic
application.solution: B。解析：以爱情故事为主线的电影可称为 romantic film（爱情片）。

grammar: n. 演奏者；表演者。由 perform + -er 构成；复数 performers。
collocations: a talented performer; a street performer; live performers
commonMistake: performer 指表演的人，performance 指演出或表现；不要把“演出很精彩”写成 performer was exciting。

example.english: Each performer introduced a song before singing it.
example.chinese: 每位表演者都在演唱前介绍了一首歌。

application.prompt: The woman on stage played the flute and greeted the audience. She was the evening's main ___. A. performance B. performer
application.solution: B。解析：句中指台上的人，应用 performer（表演者）；performance 指表演本身。

grammar: adj. 紫色的；n. 紫色。作颜色形容词时通常不变形；a shade of purple 指一种紫色色调。
collocations: a purple dress; turn purple; a deep purple
commonMistake: purple 既可作形容词也可作名词；放在名词前修饰颜色时不加 -ly。

example.english: She wore a purple scarf to match her coat.
example.chinese: 她围了一条紫色围巾来搭配外套。

application.prompt: The flowers are not red or blue; their petals are violet in color. The petals are ___. A. purple B. wooden
application.solution: A。解析：violet（紫罗兰色）说明花瓣是 purple（紫色的）。

grammar: adj. 有天赋的。动词 gift；gifted 常用 be gifted at/with... 表示在某方面有天赋。
collocations: a gifted musician; be gifted at drawing; a gifted child
commonMistake: be gifted at 后接名词或动名词；不要把 gifted 当副词修饰动词。

example.english: The gifted pianist learned the song by ear.
example.chinese: 这位有天赋的钢琴家凭听觉学会了这首曲子。

application.prompt: At four, Nina could play difficult tunes without lessons. She is a ___ young pianist. A. gifted B. gift
application.solution: A。解析：名词 pianist 前需形容词 gifted，说明她很有音乐天赋；gift 是名词“礼物”。

grammar: n. 诗人。可数名词，复数 poets；poetry 是诗歌的总称，poem 是一首诗。
collocations: a famous poet; a poet writes poems; a modern poet
commonMistake: poet 指写诗的人，poem 指一首诗，poetry 指诗歌这一文学体裁；三者不可混用。

example.english: The poet read her new poem to the class.
example.chinese: 这位诗人把她的新诗读给全班听。

application.prompt: Mr. Lee writes verses about the sea and has published three collections. He is a ___. A. poem B. poet
application.solution: B。解析：创作诗歌的人是 poet（诗人）；poem 是作品。

grammar: n. 女警察。可数，复数 policewomen；对应的男性形式是 policeman。
collocations: a policewoman on duty; ask a policewoman for help; police officers
commonMistake: policewoman 的复数是 policewomen，woman 变 women；不是 policewomans。

example.english: A policewoman helped the lost child find his parents.
example.chinese: 一位女警察帮助走失的孩子找到了父母。

application.prompt: At the station, two female officers greeted the visitors. The ___ were very helpful. A. policewomen B. policewomans
application.solution: A。解析：policewoman 的复数将 woman 变为 women，故填 policewomen。

grammar: adj. 聋的；听不见的。be deaf in one ear 表示一只耳朵听不见；名词 deafness。
collocations: be deaf; deaf in one ear; a deaf student
commonMistake: deaf 是形容词，常说 be deaf 或 be deaf in one ear；不要与 death（死亡）混淆。

example.english: The school provides captions for deaf students.
example.chinese: 学校为失聪的学生提供字幕。

application.prompt: Ben cannot hear sounds, so the film uses captions for him. Ben is ___. A. blind B. deaf
application.solution: B。解析：字幕帮助听不见声音的人理解电影，deaf 意为“聋的”。

grammar: n. 作曲家。由 compose + -er 构成；composition 可指作品或创作。
collocations: a famous composer; a music composer; compose a symphony
commonMistake: composer 是创作音乐的人；performer 是演奏或表演的人，同一人可能兼具两种身份。

example.english: The composer wrote a new piece for the school orchestra.
example.chinese: 作曲家为学校管弦乐团创作了一首新曲。

application.prompt: She created the melody and wrote all the notes before the orchestra rehearsed it. She was the ___. A. composer B. conductor
application.solution: A。解析：创作旋律和乐谱的人是 composer（作曲家）；conductor 是指挥。

grammar: adj. 电子的；电子设备的。名词 electronics 指电子学或电子设备。
collocations: electronic music; electronic equipment; an electronic device
commonMistake: electronic 表示由电子设备或电路实现；electric 通常指由电力驱动，如 electric guitar。

example.english: The museum displays old electronic equipment.
example.chinese: 博物馆展出了旧式电子设备。

application.prompt: The song was made with computers and synthesizers rather than acoustic instruments. It is ___ music. A. electrical B. electronic
application.solution: B。解析：由电脑和合成器制作的音乐是 electronic music（电子音乐）；electrical 多表示与电力系统有关。

grammar: v. 下载；n. 下载的数据。downloaded 为过去式和过去分词，downloading 为现在分词。
collocations: download a song; download an app; a free download
commonMistake: 从网络把文件保存到设备上是 download；注意其过去式直接加 -ed：downloaded，不用不规则变化。

example.english: I downloaded the concert recording to my tablet.
example.chinese: 我把音乐会录音下载到了平板电脑上。

application.prompt: The song is now saved on my phone, so I can listen without the internet. I ___ it last night. A. downloaded B. uploaded
application.solution: A。解析：把歌曲保存到手机供离线收听是 downloaded（下载）；uploaded 是上传。

grammar: n. 评分；等级。动词 rate；rating 可指某项评价分数或等级。
collocations: a high rating; a five-star rating; give a film a rating
commonMistake: rating 是评分结果，rate 是给出评分的动词；a five-star rating 中 star 作单数定语。

example.english: The album received a high rating from music reviewers.
example.chinese: 这张专辑获得了乐评人的高分评价。

application.prompt: The album received four stars out of five on the music website. It got a good ___. A. rhythm B. rating
application.solution: B。解析：四星是网站给出的 rating（评分），rhythm 指节奏。

grammar: idiom.（向某人）表示敬佩或感谢。常用 Hats off to + 人，通常放在句首作感叹。
collocations: Hats off to you; hats off to someone for doing something
commonMistake: hats off to 后接值得称赞的人；不要按字面理解为“把帽子摘下来”，也不要漏掉介词 to。

example.english: Hats off to the volunteers who organized the concert.
example.chinese: 向组织这场音乐会的志愿者们致敬。

application.prompt: The volunteers raised money for the music room in one week. ___ them for their hard work! A. Hats off to B. Hands down from
application.solution: A。解析：称赞并感谢志愿者的努力可说 Hats off to them，意为“向他们致敬”。

sources.label: Cambridge Dictionary: hats off to someone

grammar: n. 天才人物；天赋。可数名词指人，不可数用法可指非凡的才能；复数 geniuses。
collocations: a musical genius; a stroke of genius; show genius
commonMistake: genius 指人时是可数名词，前面通常要有 a/the；形容词形式是 ingenious，意为“巧妙的”。

example.english: The young chess genius won every game in the contest.
example.chinese: 这位年轻的国际象棋天才在比赛中赢下了每一盘棋。

application.prompt: At age six, Kai could solve the hardest puzzle in minutes. People called him a ___. A. genius B. guest
application.solution: A。解析：很有天赋并能迅速解题的人可称为 genius（天才）。

grammar: n. 钢琴家；钢琴演奏者。由 piano + -ist 构成，复数 pianists。
collocations: a concert pianist; a talented pianist; play as a pianist
commonMistake: pianist 指弹钢琴的人；piano 是乐器本身。注意拼写 pian-ist，不要误写成 pianest。

example.english: The pianist practiced for two hours before the concert.
example.chinese: 音乐会前，这位钢琴家练习了两个小时。

application.prompt: At the concert, the musician sat at the grand piano and played Chopin's work. She is a ___. A. pianist B. poet
application.solution: A。解析：在音乐会上演奏钢琴的人是 pianist（钢琴家）；poet 是诗人。

grammar: v. 胜过；做得比……好。过去式 outdid，过去分词 outdone；outdo oneself 表示超常发挥。
collocations: outdo a rival; outdo oneself; try to outdo someone
commonMistake: outdo 的过去式是 outdid，不能写 outdoed；完成时用 outdone，如 has outdone。

example.english: The team outdid its own record at the final meet.
example.chinese: 这支队伍在决赛中刷新了自己的纪录。

application.prompt: Mia scored 88 last time, but today she earned 94 points. She managed to ___ her previous result. A. repeat B. outdo
application.solution: B。解析：94 分超过原来的 88 分，表示 outdo（胜过）之前的成绩。

grammar: v. 拓宽；扩大。由 wide + -en 构成；widened 为过去式，widening 为现在分词。
collocations: widen a road; widen the gap; widen one's knowledge
commonMistake: wide 变动词时去 e 再加 -en：widen；不是 wideen。

example.english: The town plans to widen the road near the school.
example.chinese: 镇上计划拓宽学校附近的道路。

application.prompt: The old path was too narrow for two cyclists to pass, so workers planned to ___. A. widen it B. lengthen it
application.solution: A。解析：问题是道路太窄，解决办法是 widen（拓宽）道路；lengthen 是加长。

grammar: n. 灵魂；真挚情感；人。可数，复数 souls；with soul 可形容演奏富有感情。
collocations: a kind soul; soul music; put one's soul into something
commonMistake: soul（灵魂、情感）与同音词 sole（鞋底、唯一的）拼写和含义不同。

example.english: She put her whole soul into the final song.
example.chinese: 她全心投入地演唱了最后一首歌。

application.prompt: His voice was technically perfect, but the audience loved its deep feeling. The song had ___. A. a schedule B. soul
application.solution: B。解析：观众喜欢歌曲中真挚的情感，说明它有 soul（感染力、真情）。

grammar: phr. 轻视；蔑视。look down on 后接被轻视的人或群体；宾语是代词时放在 on 后。
collocations: look down on others; look down on someone for something; never look down on people
commonMistake: look down on 表示“轻视”，不是从高处向下看；宾语代词要说 look down on them，不说 look them down on。

example.english: A good leader never looks down on new team members.
example.chinese: 优秀的领导者从不轻视新队员。

application.prompt: Although Sam is rich, he treats every worker with respect and never ___. A. looks down on them B. looks them down on
application.solution: A。解析：短语 look down on 意为“轻视”，代词 them 放在介词 on 后。

sources.label: Cambridge Dictionary: look down on someone

grammar: adj. 波兰的；n. 波兰人、波兰语。首字母大写；Poland 是国家名，Pole 指波兰人。
collocations: Polish music; a Polish composer; speak Polish
commonMistake: 表示波兰的或波兰语时 Polish 首字母大写；polish（小写）是动词“擦亮”。

example.english: The museum held a concert of Polish music.
example.chinese: 博物馆举办了一场波兰音乐会。

application.prompt: Chopin was born in Poland, and the program featured ___ composers. A. Polish B. polish
application.solution: A。解析：此处说明作曲家的国籍，国籍形容词 Polish 必须大写；小写 polish 是“擦亮”。

grammar: n. 特征；品质；adj. 典型的。复数 characteristics；常用 characteristic of...。
collocations: a common characteristic; a characteristic feature; be characteristic of
commonMistake: characteristic 可作名词或形容词；character 是“人物、性格”，不是 characteristic 的同义词替换。

example.english: A strong beat is a characteristic feature of this style.
example.chinese: 强劲的节拍是这种风格的典型特征。

application.prompt: The bright brass sound appears in nearly every song by the band. It is a ___ feature of their music. A. characteristic B. characteristicly
application.solution: A。解析：名词 feature 前需要形容词 characteristic（典型的）；characteristicly 不是正确拼法。

grammar: adv. 自豪地；壮观地。形容词 proud；副词由 proud + -ly 构成，比较级 more proudly。
collocations: smile proudly; stand proudly; proudly display a prize
commonMistake: proudly 修饰动词，说明动作怎样发生；be 后作表语要用 proud，如 be proud of。

example.english: The children proudly showed their handmade instruments.
example.chinese: 孩子们自豪地展示了自己制作的乐器。

application.prompt: After receiving the medal, Lena held it up with a big smile. She ___ showed it to her family. A. proud B. proudly
application.solution: B。解析：副词 proudly 修饰 showed，说明她“自豪地”展示奖牌；proud 是形容词。

grammar: n. 葬礼。可数，复数 funerals；常说 attend a funeral 或 hold a funeral。
collocations: attend a funeral; a funeral service; funeral music
commonMistake: attend a funeral 表示参加葬礼；表示悼念某人可说 at someone's funeral，不把 funeral 当动词。

example.english: Many people attended the teacher's funeral.
example.chinese: 许多人参加了这位老师的葬礼。

application.prompt: Friends gathered to say goodbye to Mr. Wu after his death. They attended his ___. A. festival B. funeral
application.solution: B。解析：亲友为逝者送别的仪式是 funeral（葬礼）。

grammar: phr. 老老少少；年轻人和老年人。常作名词性表达，young and old 前可加 people。
collocations: people young and old; welcome young and old; for young and old
commonMistake: young and old 概括不同年龄的人；young and the old 中 old 前加 the 会改变表达结构。

example.english: The music festival attracted people young and old.
example.chinese: 这场音乐节吸引了男女老少。

application.prompt: The community concert welcomed children, parents, and grandparents alike. It was open to ___. A. young and old B. young or older
application.solution: A。解析：表示不分年龄、老少皆可参加，用并列短语 young and old。

grammar: n. 职业；行业。可数，复数 professions；professional 可作名词“专业人士”或形容词“职业的”。
collocations: choose a profession; the teaching profession; a medical profession
commonMistake: profession 通常指需要专业训练的职业；professional 可作形容词，不能在名词前误用 profession。

example.english: Music became her profession after years of training.
example.chinese: 经过多年的训练，音乐成为了她的职业。

application.prompt: After finishing medical school, he chose medicine as his ___. A. professor B. profession
application.solution: B。解析：把医学作为自己的职业可说 choose medicine as a profession；professor 是教授。

grammar: n. 贡献；捐款。动词 contribute；常用 make a contribution to...，to 是介词。
collocations: make a contribution; a contribution to music; contribute money to a cause
commonMistake: make a contribution to 后接名词或动名词；动词 contribute to 中的 to 也作介词，后接 -ing。

example.english: Her research made an important contribution to music education.
example.chinese: 她的研究为音乐教育作出了重要贡献。

application.prompt: Each student gave ten dollars to help buy instruments. They made a small ___ to the music fund. A. contribution B. conclusion
application.solution: A。解析：捐款帮助音乐基金是 make a contribution to（为……作贡献）。

grammar: n. 动画片；漫画。可数，复数 cartoons；cartoon character 指卡通人物。
collocations: watch a cartoon; a cartoon film; draw a cartoon
commonMistake: cartoon 可指动画片或漫画；若强调真人出演的电影，不用 cartoon。

example.english: The children watched a cartoon about a clever musician.
example.chinese: 孩子们看了一部关于聪明音乐家的动画片。

application.prompt: The film showed drawn characters moving and talking, so the children laughed at the ___. A. concert B. cartoon
application.solution: B。解析：以绘制角色为主的动画短片是 cartoon（动画片）。

grammar: adj. 公平的；合理的；n. 露天游乐场；集市。fairly 是副词，fairness 是名词“公平”。
collocations: a fair decision; a book fair; a fair share
commonMistake: fair 可表示“公平的”或“集市”；fairly 通常作副词，不要用 fairly 作名词。

example.english: The teacher gave each group a fair chance to perform.
example.chinese: 老师给了每个小组公平的表演机会。

application.prompt: Both teams followed the same rules and had equal time on stage. The contest was ___. A. fair B. empty
application.solution: A。解析：双方规则和时间相同，比赛是 fair（公平的）。

grammar: idiom. 光明正大地；完全公平地。常作副词短语修饰 win、beat 等动词。
collocations: win fair and square; beat a team fair and square
commonMistake: fair and square 在该习语中表示“光明正大地”，不是分别形容公平和方正；常放在动词后。

example.english: Our team won the final fair and square.
example.chinese: 我们队光明正大地赢得了决赛。

application.prompt: The judges checked the scores, and no one broke a rule. Our team won ___. A. in a circle B. fair and square
application.solution: B。解析：比赛没有违规、胜利完全公平，表达“光明正大地赢”用 fair and square。

grammar: n. 磁带；胶带；v. 用磁带录音或录像。可数，复数 tapes；tape recorder 指磁带录音机。
collocations: a tape recording; a cassette tape; tape a concert
commonMistake: tape 可表示磁带或胶带，需看上下文；磁带作录音媒介时不等于 tape recorder（录音机）。

example.english: My father still keeps a tape of his first concert.
example.chinese: 我父亲仍保存着他第一次音乐会的录音带。

application.prompt: The old recorder played a cassette from 1985. My mother kept the music on a ___. A. tape B. screen
application.solution: A。解析：录音机里的旧式盒带是 tape（磁带），screen 是屏幕。

grammar: v. 轻敲；打节拍；n. 水龙头；轻敲声。过去式 tapped，现在分词 tapping，需双写 p。
collocations: tap a finger; tap someone on the shoulder; turn on the tap
commonMistake: tap 作动词变过去式或现在分词时双写 p：tapped、tapping；名词 tap 还可指水龙头。

example.english: He tapped the table twice to get our attention.
example.chinese: 他轻敲了两下桌子来引起我们的注意。

application.prompt: The conductor needed the violinist's attention without speaking. He gave her a gentle ___ on the shoulder. A. wave B. tap
application.solution: B。解析：轻敲一下可说 give someone a tap on the shoulder；tap 作名词表示轻敲。

grammar: phr. 用脚打节拍。tap one's feet to music；one's 随主语变化为 my、his、her 等。
collocations: tap one's feet to a beat; tap your feet along to music
commonMistake: 短语中的 one's 要与主语对应：She taps her feet；描述持续动作时 tap 要按规则双写 p 加 -ing。

example.english: He tapped his feet to the lively music.
example.chinese: 他随着欢快的音乐用脚打拍子。

application.prompt: While the band played, Leo's shoes moved lightly against the floor in time with the beat. He ___ to the music. A. tapped his feet B. clapped his hands
application.solution: A。解析：鞋子随节拍轻点地面，说明 Leo tapped his feet（用脚打节拍）。

grammar: n. 冠军；v. 捍卫、支持。可数名词复数 champions；动词过去式 championed。
collocations: a world champion; the defending champion; champion a cause
commonMistake: champion 作动词表示“支持、捍卫”，后接观点或事业；表示比赛冠军时它是名词。

example.english: The singer became a champion of music education.
example.chinese: 这位歌手成了音乐教育的倡导者。

application.prompt: The singer spoke at meetings and supported free music lessons for children. She chose to ___ music education. A. champion B. compete
application.solution: A。解析：主动支持并为音乐教育发声可用 champion 作动词，意为“倡导、捍卫”。

grammar: adj. 流畅的；流动的；宽松飘逸的。由 flow + -ing 构成，可修饰 melody、hair、dress 等。
collocations: a flowing melody; flowing lines; a flowing dress
commonMistake: flowing 描写连续顺畅或飘动的状态；表示“有流量的”不要把它与 flowing water 的字面义混淆。

example.english: The pianist played the flowing melody without a pause.
example.chinese: 钢琴家一气呵成地弹奏了这段流畅的旋律。

application.prompt: The violinist connected each note smoothly, with no sudden breaks. The melody sounded ___. A. broken B. flowing
application.solution: B。解析：音符衔接顺畅、没有中断，旋律听起来 flowing（流畅）。

grammar: n. 手指。可数，复数 fingers；thumb（拇指）通常单独称呼，不属于四根手指的用法。
collocations: point a finger; finger exercise; play with one's fingers
commonMistake: finger 指手指，thumb 专指拇指；按键可说 press a key with one finger。

example.english: The pianist hurt one finger during practice.
example.chinese: 钢琴家练习时弄伤了一根手指。

application.prompt: The pianist pressed the key with her index ___. A. finger B. shoulder
application.solution: A。解析：index finger 是“食指”，句中钢琴家用手指按琴键。

grammar: n. 同学；校友。可数，复数 schoolmates；可指同校学生，不一定同班。
collocations: a former schoolmate; meet a schoolmate; schoolmates from primary school
commonMistake: schoolmate 指同校同学；classmate 更明确指同班同学，不能仅凭同校就断定二人是 classmates。

example.english: I met an old schoolmate at the music competition.
example.chinese: 我在音乐比赛上遇到了一位老同学。

application.prompt: Lily and Ben went to the same school, though they were in different classes. Ben is Lily's ___. A. teammate B. schoolmate
application.solution: B。解析：两人同校但不同班，可称为 schoolmates；teammate 指队友。

grammar: adv. 现在；目前。通常置于句首或句末，用于谈论当今情况；不用于表示某个具体时刻。
collocations: nowadays many people; children nowadays; life nowadays
commonMistake: nowadays 指“如今”这一时期；表示“现在这一刻”通常用 now，不说 at nowadays。

example.english: Nowadays, many students learn music through online lessons.
example.chinese: 如今，许多学生通过在线课程学习音乐。

application.prompt: In the past, people bought music on tapes. ___, many listeners use streaming apps. A. Nowadays B. Yesterday
application.solution: A。解析：句子对比过去和当今听音乐的方式，应使用 nowadays（如今）。
